maria (Docs): Hey — PR #4123 up to update SDK examples + migration notes. Quick ask: can reviewers check voice/terminology and the Python snippets formatting?

jon (Eng): Taking a look. What exactly should we prefer, "model variant" or "model family"? I saw both used.

maria (Docs): Use "model variant" in docs for serving/runtime contexts; "model family" is OK in model catalog pages. We need to be consistent in this PR.

priya (SDK): Noted. Also the TS snippet uses `createClient({})` inline — prefer the explicit `new RedwoodClient()` example for clarity.

lee (PM): FYI, we promised clarity for customers migrating from hosted to dedicated. Make sure migration guide mentions config keys: `region` vs `deployment_region`.

maria (Docs): Good catch. Also the code fences for the Python example are missing language tag; netlify preview won't syntax highlight. Please add ```python

jon (Eng): Found two broken links in the migration guide pointing at /v1/old-api. Will push a quick fix.

ci-bot: docs-preview: build queued for branch docs/sdk-examples-4123 — https://docs-preview.internal/preview/4123

priya (SDK): I updated TS snippet to `new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })` and added a comment about token rotation.

maria (Docs): One more style nit: replace "you" voice with neutral voice where possible. e.g., "You can set" -> "Set".

jon (Eng): Pushed link fixes and fenced python blocks. Also bumped the example to use `async with client:` pattern for py sample.

lee (PM): Can we target merge by EOD PST if CI passes? Customers are waiting on the migration note.

maria (Docs): EOD PST works if docs-preview shows no regressions and at least two reviewers approve.

priya (SDK): I'm +1 on content and code changes. Leaving a formal review now.

jon (Eng): +1 as well. Left a small comment about a variable name (`client` vs `rw_client`) but not blocking.

maria (Docs): Thanks — tagging @here for merge window: if no more blocking comments by 17:00 PST I'll merge after green preview. :thumbsup:

lee (PM): Approved on product side. :rocket:

priya (SDK): Thanks — will sync with release notes.

jon (Eng): Nice. Closing the thread.
